name: Cheshire and Warrington
tagline: The North's most productive economy: jet engines, medicines and clean power, made here.
erb_name: South and North Cheshire Chamber of Commerce
lsip_title: Cheshire & Warrington Local Skills Improvement Plan 2026-2029
summary: Cheshire and Warrington is the most productive sub-region in the North of England, built on advanced manufacturing, life sciences, clean energy and a fast-growing professional services base. The LSIP wants training to catch up with employer demand for technicians and higher-level technical skills, while widening access for young people, rural residents and those furthest from work.
